name: Stability
covers: The app crashing, freezing, force-closing, not opening, or getting stuck
not_for: Slowness while the app still works (performance)

name: Speed and resource use
covers: Slow loading, lag, stutter, long waits, battery drain, heat, storage or data usage

name: Account and login
covers: Sign-up, sign-in, passwords, verification codes, being logged out, account access, bans, or deleting the account

name: Pricing, subscription, and billing
covers: Price, paywalls, free-tier limits, subscriptions, trials, charges, refunds, or cancelling

name: Advertisements
covers: How many ads appear, how long or loud they are, or how intrusive they feel
not_for: Paying to remove ads, which is pricing

name: Design and navigation
covers: Layout, visual design, navigation, finding things, readability, text size, accessibility, or a redesign
not_for: Missing functionality that is not about how existing features look or are reached

name: Content quality and relevance
covers: The quality, accuracy, quantity, or relevance of the content, catalog, results, or recommendations the app provides
not_for: How the content is laid out on screen

name: Notifications
covers: Push notifications, reminders, or emails being too many, missing, late, or impossible to turn off

name: Data, sync, and offline
covers: Lost data or progress, saving, syncing between devices, backups, or offline use

name: Devices and integrations
covers: Specific phones, tablets, OS versions, watches, cars, TVs, speakers, or connections to other apps and services
not_for: Problems that happen on every device

name: Customer support
covers: Contacting the company, response times, or how helpful support or the help center was
not_for: The product problem the reviewer contacted support about

name: Privacy and security
covers: Permissions, tracking, data collection or sharing, hacked accounts, scams, or safety concerns
not_for: Forgotten passwords or ordinary login trouble
